Notices

How to get news in the Post

Piedmont Post · October 7, 2026 · 1 min read

The Piedmont Post welcomes its readers to express their opinions on any topic. Columns in the Piedmont Post are exclusive and may not be reprinted without permission.

The Post reserves the right to edit any pieces or letters submitted. Opinion pieces should be limited to 400 words, letters to the editor to 200 words.

Photo submissions: Please submit photos at 6 inches in width and at a resolution of 200 dpi in jpeg format.

Do you have some news? Send your photos or stories to 3756 Grand Ave., #203, Oakland, CA 94610, or email them to news@piedmont-post.com. It’s that easy. (Send us an attachment or cut and paste your text into the body of the email.)

The deadline for submitting news, photos and opinion items is Friday.
